notes:
**Board comments below 60% zoom** (CHR-1260 / CHR-1261). Fit all at 42% (mini tiles 76 px = 180 × 0.42; 17 columns bind the canvas width, as in `board-view-zoomed-out`). Labels and element pins are hidden below 60%, as for names (chr-621 rule).

**One count dot per screen:** `comment-count-chip` variant `dot`, 18 px, **inside** the tile's top-left corner (inset 4 px). The inset keeps it clear of both its own pinned `pin-button` (top-right) and the neighbour tile's pin button across the 4 px gap. The count covers the screen's open threads, capped at "99+" (aria-label carries the real number). It turns amber (`dot-detached`) when any of them is detached. With Show resolved on, resolved threads are not counted; the dot shows open threads only. A screen with no open thread has no dot.

**Click on a dot (decision):** it opens the screen's **read-only thread list** anchored at the dot (→ `board-comments-zoomed-out-list`). It does not jump to the Screens view. Rationale: at this zoom you are surveying the whole project, and a list keeps that context while still answering "what is being discussed here". Zooming in stays one scroll or double-click away.

A11y: dots are buttons with "N open comments" / "N open comments, M detached" labels and `aria-expanded`. Tab order follows the tile order.
